headline: US Equities Decline as Tech Sector Leads Market Rotation
summary: The S&P 500 experienced its largest daily decline in over a year, driven by a sell-off in technology stocks. Investors are re-evaluating the sustainability of AI-related investments as previous market leaders face a significant rotation.
why: The S&P 500 is a benchmark index for the US equity market, and the technology sector has been a primary driver of market performance in recent years due to AI infrastructure spending.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: The technology sector was identified as the primary driver of the market decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The decline was triggered by investor concerns regarding the durability of AI infrastructure spending and a broader rotation out of the year's top-performing trades.
